text: This major aims to cultivate a better understanding of Chinese tradition and Chinese culture, and a good feeling towards China; Master the basic knowledge, theories and methods of economics and international economics and trade; Familiar with internationally accepted economic and trade rules, international economic operation mechanisms and development laws; Have certain business data analysis ability, proficient in modern information technology; Good communication, coordination skills and innovative and entrepreneurial spirit; Applied, innovative professionals with a global vision who can engage in international trade and business related work.The basic school system of this major is 4 years, the implementation of 4-6 years flexible school system, students who meet the graduation requirements can be awarded a bachelor's degree in economics.Core courses: Calculus, Microeconomics, Finance, Statistics, International trade, cross-border e-commerce, basic accounting, etc
